attributes.modifications: The publisher, dynamical.org, restructured the source data into an Icechunk virtual Zarr dataset of references to the unmodified source chunks, renamed its variables and dimensions, and applies read-time filters that convert temperatures from kelvin to degrees Celsius, geopotential to geopotential height (dividing by 9.80665 m s-2), and 6-hour total precipitation from metres of water equivalent to kg m-2. Values are otherwise the unchanged model output.
